Trs.

UND_Bulette
Bulettes are a type of Monstrosity and non-playable race in Baldur's Gate 3. They are armoured monsters that burrow through underground tunnels and can suddenly erupt from the ground to strike. A single bulette can be found burrowing through the Underdark.
“
The bulette's deep burrowing and powerful leap makes it an apex predator in nearly every terrain it finds itself in.
„
— In-game racial description

About

Bulettes are extremely dangerous monstrosities. Their natural armour consists of thick plates layered across their bodies. They are typically native to hill environments but can be found in many different locations. Bulettes are sometimes referred to as  Landsharks.

A bulette's  Territorial passive feature causes them to prioritise other monstrosity creatures. This can be used to the party's advantage when luring the bulette to fight other creatures.

Gallery

Notes

  • The Bulette in the Underdark has scripted appearances at X: 120 Y: -175 and X: 160 Y: -150.
  • The Bulette grants 150 XP when killed.
  •  Glut can reanimate the Bulette. It is one of the toughest and highest-damage creatures that Glut can control; however, due to its large size, it may struggle to navigate tight areas and cannot climb ladders or similar devices.
  • Applying  Bone Chilled or  Arrow of Ilmater to the Bulette before it uses  Burrow prevents it from healing as it exits combat.
  • The healing only restores its real hit points, not the temporary ones it has in Honour Mode.
  •  Command does not stop it from burrowing, but the Command applies when it next appears.
  • The Bulette is suggested to be the entity which speaks with the party when  Speak with Animals is used on the deep hole in the Underdark.
  • Polymorphing the Bulette in Honour Mode does not remove its temporary hit points or its legendary action gained from Diamond Scales, but it prevents the Bulette from fighting back, allowing for the removal of Diamond Scales while the Bulette is defenceless.

Bugs

  • In Honour Mode, if  Enlarge is cast on a reanimated Bulette (or it drinks an  Elixir of the Colossus), it regains its  Diamond Scales and can use its Legendary Action  Shredding Scales.[verify]
